per_label_direction_plan: Every target label uses direction-contrastive pairs (equal aligned/contradictory counts) to preserve the direction-consistency design; raw generation is 3x the accepted target per label/direction.
expected_acceptance_rate: 33-60% conservative (historical tiny-pilot acceptance was 5/6, but stricter direction rules and new labels justify a 3x raw buffer); keep the best candidates up to the per-label targets.
verification_workflow: local structural validation (schema, actor-in-evidence, failure/alignment dominance checks)
verified-pool update as a new timestamped folder
stopping_conditions: any official data or evaluation.py change
acceptance rate below 20% (regenerate with tightened constraints instead of lowering the bar)
any candidate requiring direction convention deviation
what_not_to_claim: no recall/DRR improvement claims until the expanded A/B run completes with 3-5 seeds
the smoke run's DRR drop is NOT attributable to the 6 candidates (it concentrates in untouched L1=45)
single-seed results are trajectory-sensitive (early stop epoch differed 5 vs 11)
